subject: Social Media
title: Engagement Signals
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Engagement Signals.

hook.text: Every like is a vote. Every comment is a louder vote. Every share screams: show this to everyone.

buildup.text: Algorithms rank content using signals—reactions, saves, time spent, clicks, and replies.

discovery.text: Not all signals weigh equally. Shares beat likes. Comments beat shares. Conversation wins.

twist.text: This creates perverse incentives. Outrage sparks the most comments, so algorithms amplify outrage.

climax.text: Platforms added 'downvotes' to improve signals. Reddit proved downvotes just create groupthink.

punchline.text: The algorithm learns what you reward.

quiz.question: Which engagement signal do algorithms typically weight most?
